about: Facts checked against English Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0) by an independent agent; no text copied; held out from tuning; not shipped.
verifiedBy: independent agent (read from the article wikitext, not checked by a person)
method: Catalog rows minus every stationId in layout-oracle.json stations and declined. Complex = complexId shared by more than one catalog row; complexes with any excluded row dropped, one row per complex (lowest gtfsStopId). Strata over non-complex rows: elevated = Elevated|Viaduct (128), subway = Subway (170), openCut = Open Cut|At Grade|Embankment (43); complexes (28). Each stratum sorted by gtfsStopId and k picks taken at index floor((i+0.5)*n/k): 8, 12, 5, 5. Subway quota fix: the draw had 2 four-track express (A28, A55) and no deep stations, so the three highest-gtfsStopId picks among its 2-track side-platform locals (L14, G16, 246) were replaced by: 120 (first non-excluded Subway row in gtfsStopId order whose article gives 4 tracks and 2 islands) and the two lowest-gtfsStopId of the known deep candidates 726, B04, B06, B08 whose article states a depth (B04 skipped: no depth stated). Fields: platforms counts in-service platforms (abandoned/disused noted separately); tracks counts physical tracks at the platforms (tracksInService when the infobox says fewer); mezzanine true when a level separate from the platforms (above or below, incl. a station house under an el or an enclosed crossover/overpass) connects both directions, false when the article says there is none or fare control is only at platform level, null if silent. For complexes the top-level fields describe the drawn row's own line; components lists each line.
